plugins.name: TN Performance Advisor
plugins.author: Techn
plugins.description: Turns a sanitised Query Monitor capture into a prioritised performance action plan using the WordPress AI Client.
plugins.body:
Adds a Next recommendation button to the Performance Advisor results page.

Each click recalls OpenAI using the same saved Query Monitor capture and a compact history of every recommendation already shown. The model must return the next distinct, evidence-backed implementation work order without repeating, rephrasing, splitting, or substantially overlapping an earlier result. Exact duplicate results are rejected.

Recommendations are numbered sequentially. Starting a fresh analysis from the admin bar resets the sequence. When no further supported change remains, the page reports that state and removes the Next recommendation button.

plugins.name: TN Sentinel
plugins.author: Techn
plugins.description: Protects WordPress plugin administration using a paired owner and authenticator approval.
plugins.body:
TN Sentinel v0.1.5 fixes an initial-pairing deadlock after updating the standard plugin while an older MU guardian remains installed.

Changes:
- Detect signed unpaired installations with an older or missing MU guardian.
- Offer Repair guardian and continue pairing before an owner exists.
- Protect the repair with the Sentinel capability, WordPress nonce, and explicit acknowledgement.
- Keep the bundled guardian at v0.1.4 because its enforcement code is unchanged.

After updating, open TN Sentinel, select Repair guardian and continue pairing, then complete TOTP pairing.

plugins.name: WP Migrate - Digital Asset Management
plugins.author: Techn
plugins.description: Reconciles non-production WordPress media references with a canonical production Media Library through WP Migrate.
plugins.body:
## WP Migrate - Digital Asset Management 0.1.0

Initial MVP release for manually reconciling non-production WordPress media references with a canonical production Media Library.

### Included

- Signed PROD catalogue exchange through the existing WP Migrate connection handshake.
- Push and Pull preflight checks, PROD environment verification, plugin verification, and protocol compatibility checks.
- Manual comparison of post content, excerpts, post meta, featured images, and local Media Library assets.
- Exact upload-URL remapping to PROD for catalogue matches.
- Local materialisation of missing production-backed featured images.
- WordPress-native settings UI, explicit Check and Resync actions, multisite PROD subsite targeting, and GitHub-native updates.

### Current boundary

Local-only assets are reported but are not promoted to PROD in this release. No scheduled or background synchronisation is registered.
